name: Grinnell College
summary: Residential liberal arts college founded in 1846 in Grinnell, Iowa: about 1,700 students, a 9:1 student-faculty ratio and one required class.

ib.text: No minimum IB score is published. Official IB results are required as external exam results; SAT or ACT scores are optional. Fall 2027 applicants who need it show English proficiency.

notes: Grinnell is need-aware for international students: your demonstrated need is weighed in admission, but it commits to meeting 100% of institutionally determined need for those it admits who apply by the deadline.
If you do not apply for financial aid with your first-year application, you cannot request it in later years.
For 2026-27, tuition is $73,582 and the total cost of attendance on campus is about $93,338.
